meta.title: Bulk counter offer sent without the optional note
gaps: Verify that the backend request omits the optional note.
Assert individually that the Counter Offer Requested tag appears above every vendor's name when the exact vendor count is not specified.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Verify that the backend request omits the optional note.; Assert individually that the Counter Offer Requested tag appears above every vendor's name when the exact vendor count is not specified.

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ responses screen containing several vendor bids.
Open the bulk counter-offer drawer from the event settings menu.

args.goal: In the bulk counter-offer drawer, select Price, enter a new counter-offer value, leave the optional note empty, and click Send Counter Offer; stop when the drawer reports the send succeeded.

steps.note: Perform the form interaction without inventing an unspecified price or note field value.
Assert the success feedback reported after sending the bulk counter offer.
Assert that the counter-offer requested tag appears for multiple vendor bids.
